What is different
This version does not detect regions from the black lines. The regions are hand-authored and invisible. Your stroke is clipped to the exact region where the Pencil first touches. Paint sits above the guide, so it covers the line and number.
Select a color, then begin inside a mapped numbered area.

Reference
For this engine test the same clean numbered fish is used as the reference. The important test is the clipping behavior.
